card.title: Relationship Ledger
card.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to collect my things. I work Sundays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Saturday lunch buys the hallway. Your records are in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring lunch for both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That gets you the records. Stay to listen to one with me and I'll help carry the boxes.

mechanism: A prices restored access and supportive help in visits, lunch and listening together.
confusable: Unlike a straightforward property collection, A must turn each relational benefit into a separate exchange term.
comparison: D94-b sells hallway and records access through closeness; D94-a sells forgiveness and silence through exhibition help.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
